title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting: the 'variations sur l'équation des lacets' manuscript, where Grothendieck studies 2x2 matrix models of the generators of SL2(Z) (or GL2) acting on the fundamental groupoid of P1 minus {0,1,∞} / M_{1,1}. The notation is:
- ε0 = [[1,-1],[0,1]], so ε0^{-1} = [[1,1],[0,1]], and ε1 = [[1,0],[1,1]] are the two unipotent (elementary) matrices.
- ρ = [[0,1],[v,w]] is an order-3-type element in companion form.
- σ is an order-4-type element, determined by parameters v', w' (previous page).
- A tilde denotes the image in PGL2.

Completion of the lemma from p.326. Condition 2° (σ̃²=1) gives w=1. Then ρ³ = [[v, v+1],[v(v+1), 2v+1]] (formula 23). It is scalar only if v+1=0, i.e. v=-1, which is condition 3°. Then ρ³ = -1. So 2°+3° ⇔ σ²=-1 ⇔ σ̃²=ρ̃³=1, and these force ρ³=-1, i.e. ρ=[[0,1],[-1,1]] and σ=[[0,-1],[1,0]]. These are the standard generators S and ST (up to convention) of SL2(Z).

Remark. These conditions imply four relations:
- (24) ε0 = σρ
- (25) ε1 = ρσ
- (26) ρε1 = ε0^{-1}
- (27) ρ²σ = ε0^{-1}
Grothendieck then asks for the converse implications. (24) is equivalent to (25) by conjugating with ρ: ρ(σρ)ρ^{-1} = ρσ. Comparing ε0 = σρ with ε0 = -σ^{-1}ρ (formula 7) gives σ²=-1.

Direct computation: ρε1 = [[1,1],[v+w,w]]. So (26) holds iff w=1 and v=-1, i.e. iff ρ is fixed as above. He then attempts (27) by 'calcul brutal' of ρ²σ. On the next page this yields ρ²σ = ε0^{-1} ⇔ v=-w², w³=1. Using ε0^{-1} = -ρ^{-1}σ, (27) is equivalent to ρ³=-1. A lemma follows: ρ̃³=1 iff v=-w², and then ρ³ = -w³·1.

Purpose: to pin down normalized matrix representatives of the generators of SL2(Z) (σ of order 4, ρ of order 6, σ²=ρ³=-1) and their relation to the elementary matrices ε0, ε1, presumably as the linear model of the braid/loop equations.
errors: Minor: the page writes 'ρ²σ = -ε0^{-1}' in one place where the relation being tested is (27) ρ²σ = ε0^{-1'}; the sign slip is corrected on the next page.

The entries of the general ρ²σ matrix are partly garbled and depend on σ's parametrization. The final result on the next page (v=-w², w³=1) is consistent. All checkable computations are correct: (23), ρε1, σρ=ε0, ρσ=ε1 for the specialized matrices.

ideas.what: Normalization of the generators of SL2(Z): σ=[[0,-1],[1,0]] and ρ=[[0,1],[-1,1]], with σ²=ρ³=-1 and σρ, ρσ the elementary unipotents
ideas.modern_name: Standard presentation SL2(Z) = Z/4 *_{Z/2} Z/6 (generators S, ST)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical (19th century; Klein, Fricke; Serre's Trees)
ideas.where_published: Implicitly in Esquisse d'un programme / La Longue Marche discussions of SL2(Z) and the Teichmüller tower

ideas.what: Characterizing the relations ρε1=ε0^{-1} and ρ²σ=ε0^{-1} in terms of the companion-matrix parameters (v,w)

deep.surprise_reason: Routine 2x2 matrix verification of standard SL2(Z) relations; part of the scaffolding for the loop-equation study, with no new content.
transcription_corrections: First line likely reads 'donc la condition s'écrit v=-1'.
In 'égalité ρ²σ = -ε0^{-1}' the intended target relation is (27) ρ²σ = ε0^{-1}; the minus sign appears to be a slip.
The margin note reads approximately '[à] cela près [de] la dernière (27)'.
